description: This source file contains the PHP class definition for 'FilterGroup' within the Opencart admin module's catalog model. It provides methods to manage filter groups, including add, edit, delete, and retrieve filter group data, descriptions, and counts.

classes.name: FilterGroup
classes.description: This class manages filter groups, including CRUD operations and retrieval of filter group data, descriptions, and total counts.

methods.name: addFilterGroup
methods.description: Inserts a new filter group into the database, adds descriptions for multiple languages, and clears the related cache.

methods.name: editFilterGroup
methods.description: Updates a filter group identified by its ID, replaces its descriptions, and clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteFilterGroup
methods.description: Deletes a filter group and its descriptions by ID, and clears the cache.

methods.name: getFilterGroup
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a filter group by ID, including join with description for current language.

methods.name: getFilterGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all filter groups, with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a filter group across different languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves filter group descriptions filtered by a specific language ID.

methods.name: getTotalFilterGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of filter groups in the database.
